<subject>Tasman Ridge Resources – Cost-Effective Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, flexibility, and round-the-clock productivity are the hallmarks of Meridian Logistics Partners. Our fast and flexible on-site/off-site, offshore 24x7 delivery model lends itself to a full spectrum of specialised services – from port operations management, rail fleet maintenance, and logistics modernisation to full supply-chain outsourcing, including warehouse and distribution centre operations.

We can offer Tasman Ridge Resources our Certified SAP and Oracle professionals are available at A$28/hr to work on your projects. We have nearly 500 employees and state-of-the-art logistics facilities. Our Operational Hubs in Fremantle are considered the "crown jewel" of our network and is a key distinguisher for you.

https://www.meridianlogistics.com.au/

Over the years, our Regional Service Centres (RSCs) in Fremantle have achieved an impressive record of project accomplishments for our Australian, European, and Asian customers.

Our Innovation Centres (IC's) and RSC's offer the following capabilities for our customers:

   a.. Fleet Management Systems
   b.. Port Operations and Supply Chain Optimisation
   c.. Logistics Re-engineering Services
   d.. Mining Haulage Porting Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk / Call Centre Support Services

Although all of our services can be accomplished in one of our Regional Hubs, our customers gain significant added value by utilising the power of our offshore operational capabilities. Please visit https://www.meridianlogistics.com.au/

This 24x7 development and delivery model enables Meridian Logistics to scale project staffing rapidly to meet client needs, to engage in concurrent operations and to employ a virtual 24-hour work day on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can set a quick meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.

Regards,

Martha Soto
martha.soto@tasmanridge.com.au
Phone: +61 8 9477 3142
